title: FairNVT: Fair Classification via Noise Injection in Vision Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2604.16780v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper presents FairNVT, a lightweight debiasing framework for pretrained transformer-based encoders that improves prediction fairness while preserving task performance. FairNVT is motivated by the intuition that reducing sensitive-attribute information in the representation used by the downstream classifier can facilitate fairer predictions. Our approach learns task-relevant and sensitive embeddings via lightweight adapters, applies calibrated Gaussian noise to the sensitive embedding, and fuses it with the task representation. Together with orthogonality constraints and fairness regularization, these components jointly reduce sensitive-attribute leakage in the learned embeddings and encourage fairer downstream predictions. translated_title: FairNVT：通过视觉变换器中的噪声注入实现公平分类
translated_abstract: 本文提出了FairNVT，一种用于预训练变换器编码器的轻量级去偏框架，旨在提高预测公平性的同时保持任务性能。FairNVT的动机源于一种直觉：减少下游分类器所用表示中的敏感属性信息，可以促进更公平的预测。我们的方法通过轻量级适配器学习任务相关和敏感的嵌入，对敏感嵌入施加校准的高斯噪声，并将其与任务表示融合。结合正交性约束和公平性正则化，这些组件共同减少学习嵌入中的敏感属性泄漏，并鼓励更公平的下游预测。在涵盖视觉和语言的三个数据集上，FairNVT降低了敏感属性攻击者的准确率，改善了人口统计均等差异和均等几率等公平性指标，并保持了任务性能。
tldr: FairNVT通过轻量级适配器和噪声注入减少敏感属性信息泄漏，在保持任务性能的同时提升视觉和语言任务的预测公平性。
en_tdlr: FairNVT reduces sensitive-attribute leakage via lightweight adapters and noise injection, improving prediction fairness in vision and language tasks while preserving task performance.
